trackdown_upload

trackdown_upload.Rd

This function automates a trackdown upload to google drive based on the script of upload_trackdown.R

Usage

trackdown_upload(ul_filePattern = "upload_trackdown.R", force = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

ul_filePattern

the file pattern for the script used to automate the upload

force

logical. should the function continue if multiple scripts are identified

...

additional argument passed to function

Value

nothing
